name: AvatarGroup
summary: A few overlapping avatars and a +N count for the rest, named as one group.
useWhen: Who is on a board, a thread or a call, in the space of one control
Assignees or viewers in a table row or a card footer
A share summary next to a Share button
avoidWhen: Each person needs an action of their own: remove, change role
The names matter more than the faces

insteadUse.People you act on one by one: List with an Avatar in each row's start part
insteadUse.Names that must be read: Chip per person, or a List
insteadUse.The full list behind the count: onOverflowClick opening a Popover with a List

label.description: The name of the group, read before the avatars: 5 people, Shared with 5 people.

children.description: Avatar elements. The group sets their size and data-part item.

size.description: Sets every avatar and the count, from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

max.description: How many avatars show before the count.

total.description: The full number of people when it is more than the avatars passed. Default the number of children.

overflowLabel.description: (hidden) => words for the count. Default "N more". When the count is a Button its name is "+N, " and these words, so the name starts with the visible text (WCAG 2.5.3). Pass it in Arabic.

onOverflowClick.description: Makes the count a Button (data-ds button, data-part overflow), for example to open the full list.

a11y.role: group, named by label. Each item is an Avatar (role img, named by the person). The count is role img named by overflowLabel, or a button.
a11y.focus: Not focusable, except the count when onOverflowClick makes it a Button.

keys.Tab: Reaches the count when it is a Button

a11y.announce: The group label, then each shown person by name, then the count in words (2 more). The visible +N text is hidden.
notes: Each item overlaps the one before it on the start side (margin-inline-start), so the overlap flips in right to left layouts.
The count Button keeps the 24px minimum target at xs (WCAG 2.5.8).
Each item keeps a ring of the surface color, so overlapping faces stay apart without color alone.

en.label: A count of people in sentence case: 5 people, Shared with 5 people.
en.overflowLabel: N more. The button form reads +N, N more.

ar.label: The count with the Arabic plural, Western digits: 5 أشخاص، شخصين، 12 شخص.
ar.overflowLabel: With the Arabic plural: واحد ثاني، شخصين ثانيين، 3 آخرين، 11 شخص ثاني.

react.note: Motion: none of its own; each Avatar image fades in (fade-rise, opacity only). The count is a Button when onOverflowClick is set; the Popover pairing comes with Popover.

styles.studio: Circles cut apart by a ring of bg.surface, the count on bg.surface-3.
styles.desk: The same. The count Button is a soft pill.
styles.neutral: Planned: follows the tokens, no recipe.

mistakes.right: max 4 with a +N count, and the full list behind the count

mistakes.wrong: Avatars with their own size props inside the group
